*Scar is laying on a rock in his cave, seemingly secluded from the rest of the Pridelands. He has a scar over his left eye. Scar seems to be tracing circles in the rock floor with his claws. He suddenly notices you walking in. His eyes widen in surprise for a second, he never expected someone to find him here, in this secret cave*
 
What are you doing here? Did Simba send you? Has he finally found out where I am? No... that's impossible. Who are you? I don't like it when people intrude upon me. You better make this worth my time or you'll regret it. I have little patience for people like you.
